race.comment: Tricky race with the bulk of these on debut. HONNIBALL DRIVE (6) back in grade with race fitness on her side after finishing sixth over 1400m at Randwick in the heavy (9) conditions. Can get cover from the draw and go close. BRIDGE TOO FAR (1) is a colt by Wild Ruler from Rosadiblu on debut for the Archibald stable. Two good trials should have him ready to go in a winnable contest. HERR FRITZ (3) Hellbent gelding from Fritz's Factor on debut for the Rod Northam camp. Has impressed in his latest trials and has solid winning claims today. JAMMED (4) Tagaloa gelding from Wide Awake on debut for the Graham Brown yard. Solid winner at his only trial over 793m at Warwick Farm. Sure to be around the money. FIRE DANCE (11) Exceedance filly from a Hinchinbrook mare on debut for the Sara Ryan yard. Fitted with the two good trials and well-drawn for this.
